title.en: May Your Sleep Be Good, May Your Day Be Good
title.ur: Aap ki neend achi ho, aap ka din achha ho

intro.en: A reading text about sleep: why every living thing needs it, what happens to the body, the best hours to sleep, and tips for deep sleep. Read it sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Neend ke baare mein ek parhne ka matn: har jandaar ko neend kyun chahiye, jism par kya asar hota hai, sone ka behtareen waqt aur gehri neend ke mashwaray. Aaram se jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ النَّوْمِ: لِماذا يَحْتاجُ إِلَيْهِ كُلُّ كائِنٍ حَيٍّ، وَماذا يَحْدُثُ لِلْجِسْمِ، وَأَفْضَلُ ساعاتِ النَّوْمِ، وَنَصائِحُ لِنَوْمٍ عَميقٍ. اِقْرَأْ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: النَّوْمُ ضَرورَةٌ لِكُلِّ الكائِناتِ الحَيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: an-nawmu ḍarūratun li-kulli l-kā'ināti l-ḥayyah
dialogue.en: Sleep is a necessity for all living creatures.
dialogue.ur: Neend tamam jandaron ke liye zaroori hai.

dialogue.ar: فَالقِطَطُ تَلْتَفُّ كَالكُرَةِ وَتَنامُ، وَالطُّيورُ تَنامُ عِنْدَما يَأْتِي اللَّيْلُ.
dialogue.tr: fal-qiṭaṭu taltaffu ka-l-kurati wa tanām, waṭ-ṭuyūru tanāmu ʿindamā ya'tī l-layl
dialogue.en: Cats curl up like a ball and sleep, and birds sleep when night comes.
dialogue.ur: Billiyan gend ki tarah lipat kar sotee hain, aur parinde raat aane par sote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالنَّوْمُ لِلإِنْسانِ ضَرورَةٌ حَياتِيَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: wan-nawmu lil-insāni ḍarūratun ḥayātiyyah
dialogue.en: And sleep is a vital need for people.
dialogue.ur: Insaan ke liye neend zindagi ki zaroorat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ نَفى اللهُ تَعالى عَنْ نَفْسِهِ صِفَةَ النَّوْمِ؛ فَهُوَ لا يَحْتاجُ إِلَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad nafā llāhu taʿālā ʿan nafsihi ṣifata n-nawm; fa-huwa lā yaḥtāju ilayh
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High has denied sleep for Himself; He does not need it.
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne neend ko apni zaat se door rakha hai; woh is ka muhtaj nahin.

dialogue.ar: حِرْمانُ الجَسَدِ مِنَ النَّوْمِ قَدْ يُسَبِّبُ لَهُ كَثيراً مِنَ الأَخْطارِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥirmānu l-jasadi mina n-nawmi qad yusabbibu lahu kathīran mina l-akhṭār
dialogue.en: Depriving the body of sleep may cause it many dangers.
dialogue.ur: Jism ko neend se mehroom rakhna us ke liye bahut se khatre paida kar sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: حَتَّى إِنَّ كَثيراً مِمَّنْ تَنْخَفِضُ ساعاتُ نَوْمِهِمْ بِسَبَبِ التَّعَبِ وَالتَّوَتُّرِ يَتَمَنَّوْنَ النَّوْمَ المُريحَ لِلَيْلَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: ḥattā inna kathīran mimman tankhafiḍu sāʿātu nawmihim bi-sababi t-taʿabi wat-tawattur yatamannawna n-nawma l-murīḥ
dialogue.en: Many people whose sleeping hours drop because of tiredness and tension wish for one night of restful sleep.
dialogue.ur: Bahut se log jin ki neend ke ghante thakan aur tanao ki wajah se kam ho jate hain, ek raat ki aaramdeh neend ki tamanna karte hain.

dialogue.ar: فَالنَّوْمُ يُعْطِي الجَسَدَ فُرْصَةً لِلرَّاحَةِ بَعْدَ التَّعَبِ.
dialogue.tr: fan-nawmu yuʿṭī l-jasada furṣatan lir-rāḥati baʿda t-taʿab
dialogue.en: Sleep gives the body a chance to rest after tiredness.
dialogue.ur: Neend jism ko thakan ke baad aaram ka mauqa deti hai.

dialogue.ar: فَعِنْدَما يَنامُ الشَّخْصُ يَنْخَفِضُ كُلُّ نَشاطٍ، وَتَسْتَرْخِي العَضَلاتُ، وَتَصيرُ سُرْعَةُ دَقَّاتِ القَلْبِ وَالتَّنَفُّسِ بَطيئَةً.
dialogue.tr: fa-ʿindamā yanāmu sh-shakhṣu yankhafiḍu kullu nashāṭ, wa tastarkhī l-ʿaḍalāt, wa taṣīru surʿatu daqqāti l-qalbi wat-tanaffusi baṭī'ah
dialogue.en: When a person sleeps, all activity decreases, muscles relax, and the speed of the heartbeat and breathing becomes slow.
dialogue.ur: Jab insaan sota hai to har harkat kam ho jati hai, pathe dheele ho jate hain, aur dil ki dhadkan aur saans ki raftar sust ho jati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَكْثَرِ وَظائِفِ النَّوْمِ أَهَمِّيَّةً، أَنَّ الجِهازَ العَصَبِيَّ يَعودُ لَهُ نَشاطُهُ بَعْدَ التَّعَبِ الَّذِي حَدَثَ لَهُ وَقْتَ اليَقَظَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa min akthari waẓā'ifi n-nawmi ahammiyyah, anna l-jihāza l-ʿaṣabiyya yaʿūdu lahu nashāṭuhu baʿda t-taʿabi lladhī ḥadatha lahu waqta l-yaqaẓah
dialogue.en: One of the most important jobs of sleep is that the nervous system regains its activity after the tiredness it had while awake.
dialogue.ur: Neend ka sab se ahem kaam yeh hai ke asabi nizam thakan ke baad, jo jaagte waqt hui, dobara taza dam ho jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالنّائِمُ يَفْقِدُ – في الغالِبِ – التَّحَكُّمَ في إِرادَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wan-nā'imu yafqidu – fil-ghālib – t-taḥakkuma fī irādatih
dialogue.en: A sleeper usually loses control of his will.
dialogue.ur: Sone wala aksar apni marzi par qabu kho deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِهذا فَالنَّوْمُ ناقِضٌ لِلْوُضوءِ. حَقّاً إِنَّ النَّوْمَ نَوْعٌ مِنَ الوَفاةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa li-hādhā fan-nawmu nāqiḍun lil-wuḍū'. ḥaqqan inna n-nawma nawʿun mina l-wafāh
dialogue.en: For this reason sleep breaks wudu. Truly, sleep is a kind of death.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye neend wuzu todne wali cheez hai. Be shak neend maut ki ek qism hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا اسْتَيْقَظَ الإِنْسانُ، حَمِدَ اللهَ تَعالى عَلَى الحَياةِ مِنْ جَديدٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā istayqaẓa l-insān, ḥamida llāha taʿālā ʿalā l-ḥayāti min jadīd
dialogue.en: When a person wakes up, he thanks Allah the Most High for life anew.
dialogue.ur: Jab insaan jaag jata hai to nayi zindagi par Allah Ta'ala ki hamd karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَنَوْمُ اللَّيْلِ أَكْثَرُ فائِدَةً لِلجَسَدِ، وَأَوَّلُهُ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ آخِرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa nawmu l-layli aktharu fā'idatan lil-jasad, wa awwaluhu afḍalu min ākhirih
dialogue.en: Night sleep is more beneficial for the body, and its first part is better than its end.
dialogue.ur: Raat ki neend jism ke liye zyada faida mand hai, aur is ka pehla hissa aakhri hisse se behtar hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ جَعَلَ اللهُ تَعالى النَّهارَ لِطَلَبِ المَعاشِ وَالعَمَلِ، وَاللَّيْلَ لِلرَّاحَةِ وَالسِّتْرِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad jaʿala llāhu taʿālā n-nahāra li-ṭalabi l-maʿāshi wal-ʿamal, wal-layla lir-rāḥati was-sitr
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High made the day for seeking a living and work, and the night for rest and covering.
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne din ko rozi aur kaam ke liye, aur raat ko aaram aur parda poshi ke liye banaya.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ غَيَّرَ بَعْضُ شَبابِ هذا العَصْرِ الفِطْرَةَ في النَّوْمِ؛ فَناموا في النَّهارِ، وَسَهِروا في اللَّيْلِ؛ وَلِذا قَلَّ إِنْتاجُهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad ghayyara baʿḍu shabābi hādhā l-ʿaṣri l-fiṭrata fin-nawm; fa-nāmū fin-nahār, wa saharū fil-layl; wa li-dhā qalla intājuhum
dialogue.en: Some young people of this age changed the natural way of sleeping: they slept by day and stayed up at night, so their output decreased.
dialogue.ur: Is zamane ke kuch nojawanon ne neend ka fitri tareeqa badal diya: din mein soye aur raat ko jaage; isi liye unki paidawar kam ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: يَحْتاجُ مُعْظَمُ النّاسِ إِلى سَبْعِ أَوْ ثَمانِ ساعاتِ نَوْمٍ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ، تَزيدُ أَوْ تَنْقُصُ قَليلاً حَسَبَ طَبيعَةِ الجَسَدِ وَالسِّنِّ.
dialogue.tr: yaḥtāju muʿẓamu n-nāsi ilā sabʿi aw thamāni sāʿāti nawmin kulla laylah, tazīdu aw tanquṣu qalīlan ḥasaba ṭabīʿati l-jasadi was-sinn
dialogue.en: Most people need seven or eight hours of sleep every night, a little more or less depending on the nature of the body and age.
dialogue.ur: Aksar logon ko har raat saat ya aath ghante neend chahiye, jism aur umar ke hisab se thori kam ya zyada.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحْتاجُ الأَطْفالُ إِلى فَتَراتٍ أَطْوَلَ بِكَثيرٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaḥtāju l-aṭfālu ilā fatarātin aṭwala bi-kathīr
dialogue.en: Children need much longer periods.
dialogue.ur: Bachon ko bahut lambe waqfe chahiye.

dialogue.ar: وَالاسْتِغْراقُ في النَّوْمِ يَخْتَلِفُ مِنْ شَخْصٍ إِلى آخَرَ؛ فَالكِبارُ قَدْ يَجِدونَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ يَسْتَيْقِظونَ مَرّاتٍ عَديدَةً خِلالَ اللَّيْلِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-istighrāqu fin-nawmi yakhtalifu min shakhṣin ilā ākhar; fal-kibāru qad yajidūna anfusahum yastayqiẓūna marrātin ʿadīdatan khilāla l-layl
dialogue.en: How deeply people sleep differs from one person to another; adults may find themselves waking up many times during the night.
dialogue.ur: Neend ki gehrai har shakhs mein alag hoti hai; bade log raat mein kai baar jaag jate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُقَدِّمُ الأَطِبّاءُ بَعْضَ النَّصائِحِ مِنْ أَجْلِ نَوْمٍ عَميقٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa yuqaddimu l-aṭibbā'u baʿḍa n-naṣā'iḥi min ajli nawmin ʿamīq
dialogue.en: Doctors give some advice for a deep sleep.
dialogue.ur: Doctor gehri neend ke liye kuch mashwaray dete hain.

dialogue.ar: النَّوْمُ في مَكانٍ هادِئٍ وَمُظْلِمٍ، وَفي سَريرٍ مُريحٍ.
dialogue.tr: an-nawmu fī makānin hādi'in wa muẓlim, wa fī sarīrin murīḥ
dialogue.en: Sleep in a quiet, dark place, in a comfortable bed.
dialogue.ur: Pursukoon aur andheri jagah mein, aaramdeh bistar par sona.

dialogue.ar: المُحافَظَةُ عَلَى ساعاتِ نَوْمٍ مُنْتَظِمَةٍ، وَالاسْتِيقاظُ في الوَقْتِ نَفْسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-muḥāfaẓatu ʿalā sāʿāti nawmin muntaẓimah, wal-istīqāẓu fil-waqti nafsih
dialogue.en: Keep regular sleeping hours and wake up at the same time.
dialogue.ur: Neend ke ghanton ki pabandi karna aur ek hi waqt par jaagna.

dialogue.ar: عَدَمُ الذَّهابِ إِلى الفِراشِ، إِلاّ عِنْدَما يَشْعُرُ الشَّخْصُ بِالنُّعاسِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿadamu dh-dhahābi ilā l-firāsh, illā ʿindamā yashʿuru sh-shakhṣu bin-nuʿās
dialogue.en: Do not go to bed except when the person feels sleepy.
dialogue.ur: Bistar par sirf tab jana jab neend aane lage.

dialogue.ar: وَهَكَذا، لا عَجَبَ أَنْ يُقالَ: طابَ نَوْمُكُمْ... طابَ يَوْمُكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa hākadhā, lā ʿajaba an yuqāl: ṭāba nawmukum… ṭāba yawmukum
dialogue.en: So it is no wonder it is said: may your sleep be good... may your day be good.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye koi hairat nahin ke kaha jata hai: aap ki neend achi ho... aap ka din achha ho.

q.en: According to the text, who needs sleep?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq neend kise chahiye?
q.ar: حَسَبَ النَّصِّ، مَنْ يَحْتاجُ إِلى النَّوْمِ؟

q.en: Which sleep is described as more beneficial for the body?
q.ur: Kaun si neend jism ke liye zyada faida mand batayi gayi?
q.ar: أَيُّ نَوْمٍ يَصِفُهُ النَّصُّ بِأَنَّهُ أَنْفَعُ لِلْجِسْمِ؟

q.en: How many hours do most people need each night?
q.ur: Aksar logon ko har raat kitne ghante chahiye?
q.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً يَحْتاجُ أَكْثَرُ النّاسِ إِلى النَّوْمِ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ؟

q.ur: «الأَرَقُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What advice is given for a deep sleep?
q.ur: Gehri neend ke liye kya mashwara diya gaya?

options: Sleep in a quiet, dark place

intro.en: Exercises on the text: true or false, matching causes with results, short answers, singular and plural words, and opposite words (antonyms). Learn the plural forms and opposites from the text.
intro.ur: Matn par mashqen: sahi ya ghalat, wajah aur nateeja milana, mukhtasar jawab, wahid jama ke alfaaz aur mutazaad alfaaz. Matn se jama aur mutazaad lafz seekhein.
intro.ar: تَمارينُ عَلى النَّصِّ: صَحيحٌ أَمْ خَطَأٌ، وَمُطابَقَةُ الأَسْبابِ بِالنَّتائِجِ، وَإِجاباتٌ قَصيرَةٌ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالجَمْعُ، وَالأَضْدادُ. تَعَلَّمْ جُموعَ الكَلِماتِ وَأَضْدادَها مِنَ النَّصِّ.

dialogue.ar: النَّوْمُ ضَرورَةٌ لِبَعْضِ الكائِناتِ الحَيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: an-nawmu ḍarūratun li-baʿḍi l-kā'ināti l-ḥayyah
dialogue.en: Sleep is a necessity for some living creatures. (True or false?)
dialogue.ur: Neend kuch jandaron ke liye zaroori hai. (Sahi ya ghalat?)

dialogue.ar: تَزْدادُ سُرْعَةُ دَقّاتِ القَلْبِ في النَّوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: tazdādu surʿatu daqqāti l-qalbi fin-nawm
dialogue.en: The speed of the heartbeat increases during sleep. (True or false?)
dialogue.ur: Neend mein dil ki dhadkan tez ho jati hai. (Sahi ya ghalat?)

dialogue.ar: يُكْرَهُ النَّوْمُ قَبْلَ العِشاءِ، وَالكَلامُ بَعْدَها.
dialogue.tr: yukrahu n-nawmu qabla l-ʿishā', wal-kalāmu baʿdahā
dialogue.en: Sleeping before Isha and talking after it are disliked. (True or false?)
dialogue.ur: Isha se pehle sona aur uske baad baatein karna napasandeeda hai. (Sahi ya ghalat?)

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ تَنامُ القِطَطُ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa tanāmu l-qiṭaṭ?
dialogue.en: How do cats sleep?
dialogue.ur: Billiyan kaise sotee hain?

dialogue.ar: مَتى يَكونُ تَنَفُّسُ الإِنْسانِ بَطيئاً؟
dialogue.tr: matā yakūnu tanaffusu l-insāni baṭī'an?
dialogue.en: When is a person's breathing slow?
dialogue.ur: Insaan ki saans kab sust hoti hai?

dialogue.ar: ما أَكْثَرُ وَظائِفِ النَّوْمِ أَهَمِّيَّةً؟
dialogue.tr: mā aktharu waẓā'ifi n-nawmi ahammiyyah?
dialogue.en: What is the most important function of sleep?
dialogue.ur: Neend ka sab se ahem kaam kya hai?

dialogue.ar: ما تَأْثيرُ الحَليبِ الفاتِرِ وَاللَّبَنِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā ta'thīru l-ḥalībi l-fātiri wal-laban?
dialogue.en: What is the effect of lukewarm milk and yoghurt drink?
dialogue.ur: Neem garam doodh aur lassi ka kya asar hai?

vocab.ur: napasand karta hai ≠ pasand karta hai

«مُراهِق» ka matlab:

intro.en: Some Arabic nouns are 'diptotes' (المَمْنوعُ مِنَ الصَّرْف): they never take tanween, and in the genitive they end with a fatha instead of a kasra. In this lesson: feminine names (فاطِمَةُ), foreign names (إِبْراهيمُ), names ending in ـان (عِمْرانَ), verb-pattern names (أَحْمَدُ), compound names (بَعْلَبَكَّ), and names on the pattern فُعَلُ (عُمَرُ).
intro.ur: Arabi ke kuch ism 'mamnoo' minas-sarf' kehlate hain: unpar tanween nahin aata, aur jar ki halat mein kasra ki jagah fatha aata hai. Is sabaq mein: muannas naam (فاطِمَةُ), ajmi naam (إِبْراهيمُ), ـان par khatam hone wale naam (عِمْرانَ), fel ke wazn par naam (أَحْمَدُ), murakkab naam (بَعْلَبَكَّ) aur فُعَلُ ke wazn par naam (عُمَرُ).
intro.ar: بَعْضُ الأَسْماءِ العَرَبِيَّةِ «مَمْنوعَةٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ»: لا تَأْخُذُ تَنْوينًا، وَتُجَرُّ بِالفَتْحَةِ بَدَلَ الكَسْرَةِ. في هذا الدَّرْسِ: أَسْماءُ المُؤَنَّثِ (فاطِمَةُ)، وَالأَسْماءُ الأَعْجَمِيَّةُ (إِبْراهيمُ)، وَما يَنْتَهي بِأَلِفٍ وَنونٍ (عِمْرانَ)، وَما عَلى وَزْنِ الفِعْلِ (أَحْمَدُ)، وَالمُرَكَّبُ (بَعْلَبَكَّ)، وَما عَلى وَزْنِ فُعَلَ (عُمَرُ).

dialogue.ar: فاطِمَةُ وَرُقَيَّةُ بِنْتا رَسولِ اللهِ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: fāṭimatu wa ruqayyatu bintā rasūli llāh
dialogue.en: Fatima and Ruqayyah are the daughters of the Messenger of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Fatima aur Ruqayyah Rasoolullah ﷺ ki betiyan hain.

dialogue.ar: يا مَرْيَمُ اقْنُتي لِرَبِّكِ.
dialogue.tr: yā maryamu qnutī li-rabbiki
dialogue.en: O Maryam, be devoutly obedient to your Lord.
dialogue.ur: Aye Maryam, apne Rab ke liye farmanbardar ban ja.

dialogue.ar: طَلْحَةُ وَحَمْزَةُ مِنَ الصَّحابَةِ الكِرامِ.
dialogue.tr: ṭalḥatu wa ḥamzatu mina ṣ-ṣaḥābati l-kirām
dialogue.en: Talha and Hamza are among the noble Companions.
dialogue.ur: Talha aur Hamza mazzez sahaba mein se hain.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ إِبْراهيمَ كانَ أُمَّةً قانِتاً لِلَّهِ.
dialogue.tr: inna ibrāhīma kāna ummatan qānitan lillāh
dialogue.en: Indeed Ibrahim was a nation (in himself), devoutly obedient to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Be shak Ibrahim ek poori ummat the, Allah ke farmanbardar.

dialogue.ar: دِمَشْقُ عاصِمَةُ سورْيا.
dialogue.tr: dimashqu ʿāṣimatu sūriyā
dialogue.en: Damascus is the capital of Syria.
dialogue.ur: Dimashq Syria ka darulhukumat hai.

dialogue.ar: شَهْرُ رَمَضانَ الَّذي أُنْزِلَ فيهِ القُرْآنُ.
dialogue.tr: shahru ramaḍāna lladhī unzila fīhi l-qur'ān
dialogue.en: The month of Ramadan in which the Quran was revealed.
dialogue.ur: Ramazan ka mahina jis mein Quran nazil kiya gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرانَ الَّتي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَها.
dialogue.tr: wa maryama ibnata ʿimrāna llatī aḥṣanat farjahā
dialogue.en: And Maryam, daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity.
dialogue.ur: Aur Maryam, Imran ki beti, jis ne apni pakdamani ki hifazat ki.

dialogue.ar: تَجِدُ الكِتابَ عِنْدَ أَسْعَدَ أَوْ أَيْمَنَ.
dialogue.tr: tajidu l-kitāba ʿinda asʿada aw aymana
dialogue.en: You find the book with As'ad or Ayman.
dialogue.ur: Kitab As'ad ya Ayman ke paas milti hai.

dialogue.ar: تَوَلّى عُمَرُ الخِلافَةَ قَبْلَ عُثْمانَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُما.
dialogue.tr: tawallā ʿumaru l-khilāfata qabla ʿuthmāna raḍiya llāhu ʿanhumā
dialogue.en: Umar took the caliphate before Uthman, may Allah be pleased with them both.
dialogue.ur: Umar ne Usman se pehle khilafat sambhali, Allah un dono se razi ho.

dialogue.ar: رَجَعْتُ مِنْ حَضْرَمَوْتَ إِلى بَعْلَبَكَّ اليَوْمَ.
dialogue.tr: rajaʿtu min ḥaḍramawta ilā baʿlabakka l-yawm
dialogue.en: I returned from Hadramawt to Baalbek today.
dialogue.ur: Main aaj Hadramawt se Baalbek wapas aaya.

intro.en: Listen to two parts and answer: true or false, choose the right answer, and match causes with results. The topic is sleep, dreams and what happens when a person does not sleep. Play the audio on the slides.
intro.ur: Do hissay sunein aur jawab dein: sahi ya ghalat, durust jawab chunein, aur wajah aur nateeja milayen. Mauzu neend, khwab aur neend na lene ke asraat hain. Slides par maujood audio chalayen.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى جُزْأَيْنِ ثُمَّ تُجيبُ: صَحيحٌ أَمْ خَطَأٌ، وَاخْتِيارُ الإِجابَةِ، وَمُطابَقَةُ الأَسْبابِ بِالنَّتائِجِ. المَوْضوعُ هُوَ النَّوْمُ وَالأَحْلامُ وَما يَحْدُثُ لِمَنْ لا يَنامُ. شَغِّلِ الصَّوْتَ عَلى الشَّرائِحِ.

dialogue.ar: لا يَشْعُرُ النّائِمُ في أَثْناءِ نَوْمِهِ بِما يَحْدُثُ حَوْلَهُ.
dialogue.tr: lā yashʿuru n-nā'imu fī athnā'i nawmihi bimā yaḥduthu ḥawlah
dialogue.en: A sleeper does not feel what happens around him during his sleep.
dialogue.ur: Sone wala neend ke dauran apne aas paas hone wali cheezon ko mehsoos nahin karta.

dialogue.ar: يَرْتاحُ عَقْلُ الإِنْسانِ وَجِسْمُهُ بَعْدَ النَّوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: yartāḥu ʿaqlu l-insāni wa jismuhu baʿda n-nawm
dialogue.en: A person's mind and body rest after sleep.
dialogue.ur: Neend ke baad insaan ka zehn aur jism aaram pa leta hai.

dialogue.ar: تَزْدادُ ضَرَباتُ قَلْبِ النّائِمِ.
dialogue.tr: tazdādu ḍarabātu qalbi n-nā'im
dialogue.en: The sleeper's heartbeats increase.
dialogue.ur: Sone wale ke dil ki dhadkanen barh jati hain.

dialogue.ar: يَتَحَرَّكُ جِسْمُ الإِنْسانِ وَهُوَ نائِمٌ.
dialogue.tr: yataḥarraku jismu l-insāni wa huwa nā'im
dialogue.en: A person's body moves while he is asleep.
dialogue.ur: Insaan ka jism sote hue harkat karta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَسْتَطيعُ الإِنْسانُ أَنْ يَصْحُوَ عَشَرَةَ أَيّامٍ مُتَّصِلَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: yastaṭīʿu l-insānu an yaṣḥuwa ʿasharata ayyāmin muttaṣilah
dialogue.en: A person can stay awake ten days in a row.
dialogue.ur: Insaan musalsal das din jaag sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: بَعْضُ النّاسِ يَتَذَكَّرونَ أَحْلامَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: baʿḍu n-nāsi yatadhakkarūna aḥlāmahum
dialogue.en: Some people remember their dreams.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log apne khwab yaad rakhte hain.

dialogue.ar: يُساعِدُ النَّوْمُ الكافي عَلى التَّفْكيرِ.
dialogue.tr: yusāʿidu n-nawmu l-kāfī ʿalā t-tafkīr
dialogue.en: Enough sleep helps with thinking.
dialogue.ur: Poori neend sochne mein madad deti hai.

intro.en: Practise speaking with a partner (questions about sleep), say the right phrase in daily situations, and write a short essay on 'Sleep and insomnia'. Learn the useful question words and phrases.
intro.ur: Saathi ke saath bolne ki mashq (neend ke sawalat), rozmarra mauqon par sahi jumla kehna, aur 'Neend aur be khwabi' par mukhtasar mazmoon likhna. Kaam ke sawaliya alfaaz aur jumlay seekhein.
intro.ar: تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الحَديثِ مَعَ زَميلٍ (أَسْئِلَةٌ عَنِ النَّوْمِ)، وَعَلى قَوْلِ العِبارَةِ المُناسِبَةِ في مَواقِفَ يَوْمِيَّةٍ، ثُمَّ تَكْتُبُ مَوْضوعًا قَصيرًا عَنِ «النَّوْمِ وَالأَرَقِ». تَعَلَّمْ أَدَواتِ السُّؤالِ وَالعِباراتِ المُفيدَةَ.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً تَنامُ لَيْلاً؟
dialogue.tr: kam sāʿatan tanāmu laylan?
dialogue.en: How many hours do you sleep at night?
dialogue.ur: Aap raat ko kitne ghante sote hain?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَنامُ في وَقْتٍ مُتَأَخِّرٍ؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: hal tanāmu fī waqtin muta'akhkhir? limādhā?
dialogue.en: Do you sleep late? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap der se sote hain? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: مَتى تَسْهَرُ كَثيراً؟
dialogue.tr: matā tasharu kathīran?
dialogue.en: When do you stay up a lot?
dialogue.ur: Aap kab bahut jaagte hain?

dialogue.ar: مَتى تَرى أَحْلاماً مُزْعِجَةً في نَوْمِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: matā tarā aḥlāman muzʿijatan fī nawmik?
dialogue.en: When do you see disturbing dreams in your sleep?
dialogue.ur: Aap ko neend mein pareshan karne wale khwab kab aate hain?

dialogue.ar: ما رَأْيُكَ في النَّوْمِ بَعْدَ صَلاةِ الفَجْرِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā ra'yuka fin-nawmi baʿda ṣalāti l-fajr?
dialogue.en: What is your opinion about sleeping after the Fajr prayer?
dialogue.ur: Fajr ki namaz ke baad sone ke baare mein aap ki kya raaye hai?

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَقولُ قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā taqūlu qabla n-nawm?
dialogue.en: What do you say before sleep?
dialogue.ur: Sone se pehle aap kya kehte hain?

dialogue.ar: ما الفَرْقُ بَيْنَ نَوْمِ اللَّيْلِ وَنَوْمِ النَّهارِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-farqu bayna nawmi l-layli wa nawmi n-nahār?
dialogue.en: What is the difference between night sleep and day sleep?
dialogue.ur: Raat ki neend aur din ki neend mein kya farq hai?

dialogue.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِلإِنْسانِ، إِذا حُرِمَ النَّوْمَ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā yaḥduthu lil-insāni, idhā ḥurima n-nawm?
dialogue.en: What happens to a person if he is deprived of sleep?
dialogue.ur: Agar insaan neend se mehroom ho jaye to kya hota hai?

q.en: How do you ask 'How many hours do you sleep?'
q.ur: 'Aap kitne ghante sote hain?' kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ عَدَدِ ساعاتِ النَّوْمِ؟

q.ur: «مَتى» kis ke baare mein poochne ke liye hai?

title.ar: الإِمْلاء: كِتابَةُ الهَمْزَةِ في أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ
title.en: Dictation: Hamza at the start of a word (Lesson 48)
title.ur: Imla: Lafz ke shuru mein hamza likhna (Sabaq 48)

intro.en: There are two kinds of hamza at the start of a word. Hamzat al-wasl (وَصْل) is dropped in the middle of speech and written as a plain alif: اسْمي، اجْلِسْ. Hamzat al-qat' (قَطْع) is always pronounced and has a mark: أ with fatha or damma, إ with kasra: أَكَلَ، أُذُن، إِبِل.
intro.ur: Lafz ke shuru mein hamza ki do qismein hain. Hamza-e-wasl darmiyan-e-kalam mein gir jata hai aur sirf alif likha jata hai: اسْمي، اجْلِسْ. Hamza-e-qat' hamesha parha jata hai aur us par nishan hota hai: fatha ya damma ke saath أ, kasra ke saath إ: أَكَلَ، أُذُن، إِبِل.
intro.ar: لِلْهَمْزَةِ في أَوَّلِ الكَلِمَةِ نَوْعانِ: هَمْزَةُ وَصْلٍ تَسْقُطُ في وَسَطِ الكَلامِ وَتُكْتَبُ أَلِفًا بِلا عَلامَةٍ: اسْمي، اجْلِسْ. وَهَمْزَةُ قَطْعٍ تُنْطَقُ دائِمًا وَلَها عَلامَةٌ: أ بِالفَتْحَةِ أَوِ الضَّمَّةِ، وَإ بِالكَسْرَةِ: أَكَلَ، أُذُن، إِبِل.

dialogue.en: My name is Muhammad. (wasl: plain alif)
dialogue.ur: Mera naam Muhammad hai. (wasl: sada alif)

intro.en: More diptotes: the pattern أَفْعَلُ (أَحْسَنُ), feminine alif endings (ذِكْرى، صَفْراءُ), the pattern فُعَلُ (أُخَرُ), numbers like مَثْنى, and the broken plurals of the 'mafā'il' type (مَساجِدُ، مَصابيحُ). Remember: no tanween, and fatha for jarr. Finally, match ideas with the paragraphs of the reading text.
intro.ur: Mazeed mamnoo' minas-sarf: أَفْعَلُ ka wazn (أَحْسَنُ), muannas alif par khatam hone wale (ذِكْرى، صَفْراءُ), فُعَلُ ka wazn (أُخَرُ), مَثْنى jaise adad, aur 'mafaa'il' wazn ki jama-e-taksir (مَساجِدُ، مَصابيحُ). Yaad rakhein: tanween nahin, aur jar mein fatha. Aakhir mein khayalat ko matn ke paragraphon se milayen.
intro.ar: مَزيدٌ مِنَ المَمْنوعِ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ: وَزْنُ أَفْعَلَ (أَحْسَنُ)، وَأَلِفُ التَّأْنيثِ (ذِكْرى، صَفْراءُ)، وَوَزْنُ فُعَلَ (أُخَرُ)، وَالأَعْدادُ مِثْلُ مَثْنى، وَجُموعُ التَّكْسيرِ عَلى وَزْنِ مَفاعِلَ (مَساجِدُ، مَصابيحُ). تَذَكَّرْ: لا تَنْوينَ، وَالجَرُّ بِالفَتْحَةِ. ثُمَّ طابِقِ الأَفْكارَ بِفِقَراتِ النَّصِّ.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمّا رَجَعَ مُوسى إِلى قَوْمِهِ غَضْبانَ أَسِفاً.
dialogue.tr: wa lammā rajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifā
dialogue.en: And when Musa returned to his people, angry and grieved.
dialogue.ur: Aur jab Musa apni qaum ki taraf ghussay aur ranj ke saath lautay.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا حُيِّيتُمْ بِتَحِيَّةٍ فَحَيُّوا بِأَحْسَنَ مِنْها أَوْ رُدُّوها.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā ḥuyyītum bi-taḥiyyatin fa-ḥayyū bi-aḥsana minhā aw ruddūhā
dialogue.en: And when you are greeted with a greeting, greet with better than it, or return it.
dialogue.ur: Aur jab tumhein salam kiya jaye to us se behtar jawab do ya wohi lauta do.

dialogue.ar: وَالفِتْنَةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنَ القَتْلِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-fitnatu akbaru mina l-qatl
dialogue.en: And persecution is worse than killing.
dialogue.ur: Aur fitna qatl se bhi bada hai.

dialogue.ar: أُولي أَجْنِحَةٍ مَثْنى وَثُلاثَ وَرُباعَ.
dialogue.tr: ūlī ajniḥatin mathnā wa thulātha wa rubāʿ
dialogue.en: Having wings, two, three and four.
dialogue.ur: Jin ke par hain, do do, teen teen aur chaar chaar.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ في ذلِكَ لَذِكْرى لِأُولِي الأَلْبابِ.
dialogue.tr: inna fī dhālika la-dhikrā li-ulī l-albāb
dialogue.en: Indeed in that is a reminder for people of understanding.
dialogue.ur: Be shak is mein aqal walon ke liye nasihat hai.

dialogue.ar: لَهُدِّمَتْ صَوامِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَواتٌ وَمَساجِدُ.
dialogue.tr: la-huddimat ṣawāmiʿu wa biyaʿun wa ṣalawātun wa masājid
dialogue.en: Monasteries, churches, synagogues and mosques would have been demolished.
dialogue.ur: Khanqahein, girjay, ibadatgahein aur masjidein dhaa di jati.

dialogue.ar: وَزَيَّنّا السَّماءَ الدُّنْيا بِمَصابيحَ وَحِفْظاً.
dialogue.tr: wa zayyannā s-samā'a d-dunyā bi-maṣābīḥa wa ḥifẓā
dialogue.en: And We adorned the lowest heaven with lamps and as protection.
dialogue.ur: Aur humne qareeb ke aasman ko chiraghon se saja diya aur hifazat ke liye.

dialogue.ar: صَلّوا أَيُّها الشَّبابُ في مَساجِدِكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: ṣallū ayyuhā sh-shabābu fī masājidikum
dialogue.en: Pray, O young men, in your mosques.
dialogue.ur: Aye nojawano, apni masjidon mein namaz parho.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ أَيّامِكُمْ يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: inna min afḍali ayyāmikum yawma l-jumuʿah
dialogue.en: Indeed among the best of your days is the day of Jumuah.
dialogue.ur: Be shak tumhare behtareen dinon mein se Jumua ka din hai.

dialogue.ar: النَّوْمُ مُريحٌ لِلجَسَدِ، وَحِرْمانُ الجَسَدِ مِنْهُ خَطَرٌ. (الفِقْرَةُ ١)
dialogue.tr: an-nawmu murīḥun lil-jasad, wa ḥirmānu l-jasadi minhu khaṭar
dialogue.en: Sleep gives the body rest, and depriving it of sleep is dangerous. (paragraph 1)
dialogue.ur: Neend jism ko aaram deti hai, aur is se mehroom karna khatarnak hai. (Paragraph 1)

dialogue.ar: النَّوْمُ في اللَّيْلِ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ النَّوْمِ في النَّهارِ. (الفِقْرَةُ ٤)
dialogue.tr: an-nawmu fil-layli afḍalu mina n-nawmi fin-nahār
dialogue.en: Sleep at night is better than sleep by day. (paragraph 4)
dialogue.ur: Raat ki neend din ki neend se behtar hai. (Paragraph 4)

vocab.ur: do do, teen teen, chaar chaar
